machine.note: Software rendering: absolute fps is not hardware-GPU performance. cpuMs is main-thread command submission; rasterMs forces the SwiftShader rasterizer to finish (render + readPixels), which is the honest per-frame cost on this machine. Draw calls, triangles, resident bytes and CPU times are the load metrics.

statePlane.source: source_data/nyc/traffic_volume.json + street_graph.json, nysp port in this script

measure.label: bench_start_ts_topdown

cpuMs.kind: main-thread renderer.render() wall time; command submission, rasterization deferred to the GPU process

rasterMs.kind: render + readPixels per frame; forces the SwiftShader rasterizer to finish synchronously (includes the ~3.7 MB readback)

gpuDropped.reason: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 exposed but queries never became QUERY_RESULT_AVAILABLE (SwiftShader)

measure.note: gpuMs only when EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 exists; software-GL times are not hardware-GPU numbers
